subject: Renewal pricing matrix and implementation checklist
messages:
From: Amy Lin <amy@elliptic-sys.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom@elliptic-sys.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal scope & flexibility request

Hi Mina and Ben,

Thanks for the chat last week. We're preparing our budget for H1-2029 and want to lock the platform economics sooner rather than later. Key asks from our side: 1) a price-hold for 12 months on the baseline commit if we sign by Oct 31; 2) a one-time onboarding/implementation credit to offset migration of two service clusters (est. 250k tokens/month each) into your Dedicated pools for Q1; and 3) the ability to burst beyond commit into a measured burst pool at a predictable uplift rather than ad-hoc overage rates.

Can you put something in writing with a simple matrix (commit tiers, discount, and one-time credits) so we can run it by procurement? Also include any operational prerequisites (VPC peering window, support SLA ramp).

—Amy
Amy Lin
Head of Platform
Elliptic Systems
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Amy Lin <amy@elliptic-sys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-03T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal scope & flexibility request

Amy —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a first-pass spreadsheet (renewal-draft-v1.xlsx) with three options:

- Option A (Baseline): 12-month commit, 15% discount off list, price-hold for 12 months, onboarding credit = $45k applied to first invoice.
- Option B (Two-tranche): 9-month partial commit + 3-month burst allowance (metered uplift 1.4x) — onboarding credit $30k.
- Option C (Aggressive CAP): 18-month commit at 18% discount with staged true-up and smaller onboarding credit ($20k).

Operationally: VPC peering setup typically takes 2 weeks after PO; Dedicated pool provisioning depends on requested GPU profile (we can reserve capacity within 4 weeks with a committed start date). SOC2 evidence and standard security artefacts are in SOC2-summary.pdf — happy to send a formal package to your procurement team.

If you like, Ben and I can break out the cost impact by environment (prod vs. batch) — that usually helps procurement map the commit to internal cost centers.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: renewal-draft-v1.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Amy Lin <amy@elliptic-sys.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-05T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal scope & flexibility request

Looping in Jonas for ops/implementation notes. A few points from legal/billing perspective:

- We can support a price-hold for 12 months tied to a signed addendum and receipt of a PO within 30 days of signature.
- Onboarding credit is fine but needs to be amortized across the first two invoices for accounting — I'll reflect that in the final term sheet.
- For burst behavior: propose a burst pool with predetermined thresholds and an uplift multiplier (1.35x) rather than open overage — that gives Elliptic predictability and keeps billing simple.

Jonas — implementation checklist items we should confirm for the mutual action plan: network window, access to staging, expected cutover weekend, runbook owner, and SLA escalation path. Can you draft the MAP?

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Amy Lin <amy@elliptic-sys.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom@elliptic-sys.com>, Elliptic Systems Billing <billing@elliptic-sys.com>
Date: 2028-10-08T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal scope & flexibility request

Thanks — this is very helpful. A couple clarifications from procurement: we prefer the amortized credit but need the dollar amounts broken down by invoice and a sample invoice for the first two months. For the burst pool, procurement will want an example utilization scenario showing cost delta at 50%, 100%, and 200% of baseline.

On SOC2: please send the full control matrix to tom and billing; they will run a quick review. Also — we need the full mutual action plan (MAP) before legal signs off. Can you include target dates for the peering window and cutover? We are aiming for go-live by 2029-01-12.

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-15T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal scope & flexibility request — agreed terms and next steps

Amy / Tom / Billing —

Thanks for the confirm. Per our call today, summary of agreed commercial items and next steps: 

1) Commercial summary (agreed):
   - Chosen option: Option A (12-month commit).
   - Commit size: 1.5M tokens/month baseline (covers the two clusters you described).
   - Discount: 15% off list for 12 months (price-hold).
   - One-time onboarding credit: $45,000 applied as amortized credit split across invoice #1 and #2 ($22,500 each).
   - Burst pool: pre-provisioned burst allowance at 1.35x uplift; example cost scenarios attached in the MAP.

2) Operational commitments and dates:
   - PO required by 2028-10-31 to lock the price-hold.
   - VPC peering window: target week of 2028-11-13 (2-week lead).
   - Dedicated capacity reservation: provisioned by 2028-12-15 for 2029-01 cutover.
   - Go-live target: 2029-01-12.

3) Deliverables attached: mutual-action-plan.docx (MAP), SOC2-summary.pdf, and a sample invoice layout. DocuSign term addendum will be shared once PO is received. HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/471-elliptic (DL-2028-ELL-0471).

4) Action items:
   - Elliptic: submit PO to billing@redwood.com by 2028-10-31.
   - Redwood (Jonas): finalize MAP with network windows and runbook owner by 2028-10-18.
   - Redwood (Ben): prepare final addendum with amortization language for credit and send DocuSign link upon PO receipt.

If that aligns, I will send the DocuSign and trigger the calendar invites for the peering window and cutover prep.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.docx, SOC2-summary.pdf, sample-invoice.pdf
